question: Which of the following best reflects the central idea of the passage?

options.text: Communication shapes shared meaning and society

solution: The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. Communication shapes shared meaning and society**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The passage describes communication as going beyond the exchange of information to include non-verbal cues, cultural context, and shared understanding. (संचार केवल सूचना साझा करने तक सीमित नहीं, बल्कि साझा अर्थ और समाज का निर्माण करता है।) • It emphasizes that effective communication builds trust, improves collaboration, and reduces misunderstandings, highlighting its role in shaping relationships and societal functioning. • Thus, communication is presented as central to shaping shared meaning and society, not just spreading information or being technological. Therefore, the correct answer is- Communication shapes shared meaning and society [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Communication only spreads information** (संचार केवल सूचना फैलाता है): The passage says communication is much more than this. • **Communication is mainly technological** (संचार मुख्य रूप से तकनीकी है): The passage mentions digital platforms but stresses broader aspects. • **Communication limits social interaction** (संचार सामाजिक संपर्क को सीमित करता है): The passage says the opposite—communication enhances interaction. 3d:T8bf, The correct answer is '**lest he should wake**'.
